review_kind: Independent mathematical, source and artifact-integrity reviews by Codex agents

resolved_findings.issue: Ancestry alone could attach a pre-X1 check to a later selected tree.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final selected research tree must equal the final X1 checked synthetic tree; that source must contain every manuscript provider.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Relabeled stale D2 receipt rejected by the tree-identity guard.

resolved_findings.issue: A generic smoke requirement could omit a required dependency workflow.
resolved_findings.resolution: Require the exact per-anchor set of focused workflow families, in addition to original/research/executable/application checks and both application OS jobs.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Dropping A3 E1 focused evidence is rejected.

resolved_findings.issue: Every basename manifest.json was excluded rather than only the root inventory.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only the exact root kit manifest is excluded; nested manifests are inventoried.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Unexpected nested manifest is covered or causes inventory mismatch.

resolved_findings.issue: The release checkout was not checked for protected-source changes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both selected research cut and current release HEAD must preserve canonical baseline blobs, including authoritative C10 inputs.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Protected release-HEAD mutation is rejected independently of an unchanged accepted source.

resolved_findings.issue: Compile and review receipts could be omitted or left stale.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final build and verification require both receipts, exact source/input/export bindings, successful captures and hashes of all four reviewed production scripts.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Receipt omission and stale input/code bindings fail final validation.

resolved_findings.resolution: Every actual main merge must exist with expected base/source parents, equal the checked synthetic tree and belong to accepted source ancestry.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Unrelated main-merge identities fail source provenance checks.

resolved_findings.issue: Scientific OPEN obligations could be deleted or promoted after rebuilding.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final release policy pins all 17 anchors/statuses, the complete approved manuscript bytes/semantics and all eight accepted scientific boundaries; drafts remain available.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Deleted claims, promoted MA2, removed scientific limitations and altered accepted boundaries are rejected.

resolved_findings.issue: Archive metadata was not checked for determinism.
resolved_findings.resolution: Archive verification checks canonical timestamps, modes, creator, compression and all other entry metadata and empty archive comment.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Eleven repacked metadata corruptions were rejected after repairing checksums.

resolved_findings.issue: Captured C10 proof contents could be internally invalid despite repaired hashes.
resolved_findings.resolution: The helper reuses authoritative structural and exact arithmetic validation, regenerates both Lean inputs and validates complete clean compiler/axiom captures without claiming a fresh Lean run.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: All seven original ZIPs pass; 20 rehashed invalid-content variants are rejected by the 21-test suite.

resolved_findings.issue: The outer C10 gate decompressed members before the helper checked fixed inventory and size limits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both outer and direct-helper entry points invoke one shared metadata-only preflight before their first ZIP member read, including the manifest: exact13 fixed members, at most4,000,000 bytes each and16,000,000 total.
resolved_findings.independent_regression: Five small rehashed inventory/size fixtures reject at both entry points with ZipFile.read never called; exact member and total limit metadata are accepted without reads. Original seven publisher archives remain unchanged.

independent_archive_controls: payload change with repaired checksum rejected
missing member with repaired checksum rejected

r10_checks.scope: Prior full28-method run remains recorded above; after R10, the21 C10 regressions and one new focused method were rerun. Full29-method discovery is required in fresh CI.

scope: Offline validation checks the captured GitHub receipts and actual local Git objects; it does not independently authenticate GitHub or replace Lean kernel checks. Scientific OPEN obligations remain explicit in the manuscript and acceptance evidence.
